requirements_mapping.requirement: Boundary probabilities on fixed time grid; no timing target in query metadata
requirements_mapping.consequence: Build all query grid IDs independently of onsets; keep onset labels and onset-bearing transcript fields private. Reject additional metadata fields or use strict allowlist.
Use frozen full catalog; no silent subject/session omission. Any excluded recording requires explicit pre-outcome justification and prevents full-population claim.

requirements_mapping.requirement: Outer person and whole movie/continuous blocks; repeated movies grouped; temporal guards cover all feature lags
requirements_mapping.consequence: Fit/adaptation/validation cannot contain test participants or test movie IDs. Same-stimulus records from other participants are exclusions. Verify guards in actual feature support, not only central timestamps.

requirements_mapping.requirement: Participant-macro boundary AUPRC and incremental log loss over acoustic/visual controls
requirements_mapping.consequence: Compute pooled-grid AP and mean log loss within each participant, then unweighted participant mean, under a declared prospective AP convention; report acoustic/visual comparator coverage and direction.

requirements_mapping.requirement: Whole-movie holdout, balanced timestamp grid, motion/loudness baselines, latency shift
requirements_mapping.consequence: Whole-movie grouping is enforceable. Balance is ambiguous and needs explicit prospective semantics. Acoustic/visual comparator predictions must derive from allowed continuous context and same split. Shift controls need no wrapping or cross-record mixing and common paired row coverage.
